title: English Practice Quiz 0606
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: You need to report a problem. You say:
options: There is an issue with the printer.
questions.explanation: There is an issue with... clearly introduces a problem.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'They clean the room.'
options: The room is cleaned by them.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: am/is/are + past participle.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
